# Mike Cubberly

> Mike Cubberly is a Chicago-based founder and go-to-market operator. He builds outbound systems, revenue infrastructure, and companies.

## Current work

- Bottle Rocket Growth: B2B outbound and GTM systems
- Bottle Rocket Racing: motorsports business development and sponsorship pipeline
- leasr.io: automotive leasing platform

## Background

Mike has more than a decade of experience across pipeline, customer success, community, partnerships, and revenue operations. His prior companies include Verkada, Primer, Glencoco, and RevGenius.

## Location

Chicago, Illinois, United States
